capture_primary_backend: SELECT pg_backend_pid() AS primary_backend_pid, (SELECT backend_start::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity WHERE pid=pg_backend_pid()) AS primary_backend_start;
verify_private_logging_guard: SELECT (current_setting('log_statement') IN ('none','ddl','mod') AND current_setting('log_min_duration_statement')='-1' AND current_setting('log_min_duration_sample')='-1' AND current_setting('log_transaction_sample_rate')::numeric=0 AND current_setting('log_parameter_max_length_on_error')='0' AND coalesce(current_setting('pgaudit.log',true),'none') IN ('none','') AND coalesce(current_setting('pgaudit.log_parameter',true),'off')='off' AND coalesce(current_setting('auto_explain.log_nested_statements',true),'off')='off' AND coalesce(current_setting('pg_stat_statements.track',true),'top')<>'all' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_settings WHERE name='auto_explain.log_min_duration' AND setting::integer>=0 AND setting::integer<7000)) AS source_logging_guard_matches;
observe_operation_context: SELECT current_user='postgres' AND session_user='postgres' AND current_database()='postgres' AS installer_identity_matches, (SELECT NOT rolsuper AND rolbypassrls FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user) AS installer_flags_match, has_column_privilege(current_user,'mip_factual.audit_connection','id','SELECT') AND has_column_privilege(current_user,'mip_factual.audit_connection','connection_string','SELECT') AND has_column_privilege(current_user,'mip_factual.audit_connection','connection_string','UPDATE') AS operation_privileges_match, (SELECT setting::integer=7000 FROM pg_catalog.pg_settings WHERE name='statement_timeout') AS statement_deadline_observed, (SELECT setting::integer=500 FROM pg_catalog.pg_settings WHERE name='lock_timeout') AS lock_deadline_observed;
restore_statement_deadline: SELECT pg_catalog.set_config('statement_timeout',$1::text,true) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $1::text AS statement_deadline_restored;
restore_lock_deadline: SELECT pg_catalog.set_config('lock_timeout',$1::text,true) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $1::text AS lock_deadline_restored;
verify_primary_completion: WITH original_backend AS (SELECT pid,xact_start,state FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity WHERE pid=$1::integer AND backend_start=$2::timestamptz) SELECT $1::integer>0 AND $2::timestamptz IS NOT NULL AS verifier_input_valid, NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM original_backend WHERE state IS NULL) AS original_backend_observable, NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM original_backend WHERE xact_start IS NOT NULL OR state LIKE 'idle in transaction%') AS primary_transaction_ended, NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_locks l JOIN original_backend b USING(pid) WHERE l.locktype='advisory' AND l.classid::bigint=((hashtextextended('qik-comparison-audit-v1',0)>>32)&4294967295::bigint) AND l.objid::bigint=(hashtextextended('qik-comparison-audit-v1',0)&4294967295::bigint) AND l.objsubid=1) AS operation_lock_released;
